methodology: V8 CPU profile: sum timeDeltas attributed to sampled leaf frames; inclusive weights count a sample once for each distinct function present in its stack. These are time-weighted samples, not an exact per-function CPU timer; native work may be charged to the enclosing JavaScript frame. Profile spans process startup, setup, sync phases, verification and cleanup. Inclusive percentages overlap.
finding: Repeated synchronous company membership and database boundary validation dominate the observed guarded SQLite path. No production optimization was implemented.
limits: One local 10-company run on an earlier identified source tree; not the final CI timing baseline.
Includes startup, setup, verification and cleanup; profiling overhead was not estimated.
Native SQLite work can be charged to the enclosing JavaScript frame; preparation, execution and locking are not separated.
